ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid buy setting up (+37)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入构筑中（+37）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✓ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

read.en: Customer capex is running AHEAD of this name's analyst revisions — an independent forward-demand signal not yet fully in consensus estimates. Variant-worth watching (not a buy signal).

caveat.en: Cross-company proxy from 5 hyperscalers' annual capex (FY2025); leads chip revenue ~2-4 quarters (indirect link for this tier). Display-only — the name's share of capex can shift; not a buy signal.

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate headwind.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率逆风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.40 ± 0.10 — high precision. Sector anchor (XLU) reads long-duration (+0.32). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.40 ± 0.10——精度高。 板块锚（XLU）为长久期（+0.32）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

detail.en: Bled-out accumulation with a low composite — the washed-out side where forward returns have historically been better. A contrarian setup, not a trigger.
detail.zh: 吸筹枯竭且综合分偏低 — 超卖一侧，历史上未来回报更佳。逆向机会，并非触发信号。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。
